Preserve when present. Diagnose incoherent captivity combinations. No canonical field.

Each non-empty string → adaptation with new id. Case/whitespace-tolerant match against adaptationMatchers → kind violence|helplessness with adapted=true and no incidentMarks. Otherwise kind=other, label=exact text, adapted=true. Empty strings dropped. Never invent incidentMarks.
Non-empty string → single disorder { new id, name = exact text, cured = false }. null/missing/empty → no disorder entry; preserve raw distinction in workflow/raw if present.
Each retained string (including interior empties if present as elements) → gear { new id, name = exact string, equipped = false }. Do not infer weapon/armor/ritual/tome subtype. Warn if count > 50.
Non-empty string → one notes.player entry { format: 'plain', content: exact text }. Empty/missing → no player note. notes.handler remains []. Do not truncate.
